• During the 72nd FIFA Congress held at **Doha, Qatar, **Gianni Infantino said that the new FIFA Forward 3.0 programme will see an increase of 25%

**​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__**

 
• **Gianni Infantino** has been elected as the President of FIFA.
 
• He was declared winner after winning majority votes in the 2016 FIFA Extraordinary Congress held in **Zurich, Switzerland.**
 
• FIFA in English International Federation of Association Football is the governing body of association for** football, futsal and beach football.**
